notes.title: Survive at all costs… before it’s too late!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Tralalero Tralala: Survive the Night[/b] is officially launching on [b]Steam very soon![/b]
Dive into a chilling world of folklore where [b]one player becomes the monster[/b] — Tralalero Tralala, Br Br Br Patapim, Trippi Troppa, or Tung Tung Tung Sahur — and hunts the survivors.
The other four must solve puzzles, complete objectives, and find a way to escape before a terrifying fate catches up with them.[/p][p]🔪 [b]Here’s what awaits you:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Unique Brainrots with haunting voiceovers[/p][/*][*][p]Generator repair mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Unpredictable gameplay and constant tension[/p][/*][*][p]Authentic sound design inspired by Italian legends[/p][/*][/list][p]🎨 [b]Heads up![/b] This is just the beginning — in the coming days, expect a complete UI overhaul, visual style improvements, and new immersive elements.[/p][p][b]Gather your friends, prepare to survive — and don’t forget:[/b]
[b]If you hear “Tung Tung Tung...” — run.[/b][/p]
